questions.question: What was the spark spread at CAISO's SP15 hub on 10 November 2026, at a heat rate of 7.0 MMBtu per MWh against Henry Hub gas, in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: The spark spread at CAISO's SP15 hub (TH_SP15_GEN-APND) on 10 November 2026 was 15.50 USD/MWh (price_board_spreads, variable spark_spread_7). This is a derived table. The day is the CAISO local operating day, and the table labels it 2026-11-10 at 00:00Z. The spread is the day-ahead daily mean of 36.50 USD/MWh (price_board_spreads, da_daily_mean) minus an assumed 7.0 MMBtu/MWh heat rate times Henry Hub gas at 3.00 USD/MMBtu (price_board_spreads, henry_hub, 10 November 2026). The 7.0 heat rate is an assumption built into the table, not a measured plant heat rate.

questions.question: What was the highest hourly demand in ERCOT in the week of Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (Central time), in MW?
questions.answer: The highest hourly ERCOT demand in the warehouse for 2-8 November 2026 (Central time) is 65,888 MW, at 3 pm Central on Monday 2 November (eia930_all_demand, entity eia930:ERCO, demand_mw, hourly). This is a maximum over only the 72 hours the warehouse holds for that week, which is not the full week, so it may not be the true weekly peak. The warehouse has no rows for 5, 6 and 7 November. It holds 24 hours on 2 Nov, 24 on 3 Nov, 18 on 4 Nov and 6 on 8 Nov. Daily maxima for the days it holds are 65,888 MW on 2 Nov, 59,935 MW on 3 Nov, 58,473 MW on 4 Nov and 51,677 MW on 8 Nov (all eia930_all_demand).

questions.question: What was the average hourly day-ahead price at ERCOT's hub average (HB_HUBAVG) in the week of Monday 2 to Sunday 8 November 2026 (Central time), in USD per MWh?
questions.answer: The warehouse can't give the full-week average, because it has no ERCOT HB_HUBAVG day-ahead prices for Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November 2026 (Central time). For Monday 2 to Friday 6 November 2026 (Central time) it holds 120 hourly day-ahead prices (spp_dam). Their mean is 39.24 USD/MWh (iso_dam_hub_prices, source table). That is a five-day figure, not the week's average. The daily table ercot_hub_prices_daily (derived) also has no rows for 7 and 8 November. Its da_mean for 2 to 6 November runs from 26.99 USD/MWh (5 November) to 58.98 USD/MWh (3 November).
